messages:
ana (DevEx): Heads-up: found a small but nasty dup-send on Android when Activity rotates during a streaming POST.

ana (DevEx): Repro: start chunked /v1/generate, rotate device mid-upload -> server sees two session-start events for same session id.

kevin (Android): Are we reusing the Request object somewhere? Retry path should clone().

ana (DevEx): Our RetryWorker serializes the Request and then newCall(request).execute() on retry. Code does not check body repeatability.

kevin (Android): That will double-send for one-shot bodies (streams). Quick fix: detect streaming via contentLength==-1 or Transfer-Encoding: chunked and mark non-retryable.

prov (QA): I repro on Pixel 5 emulator Android 12. Adding a CI test that rotates while sending; will assert server saw exactly one start_token.

ana (DevEx): Patch plan: 1) guard RetryInterceptor to skip retry when body is one-shot, 2) default SDK streaming client to retryOnConnectionFailure=false, 3) add docs note about idempotency headers.

kevin (Android): SGTM. Also recommend adding Request.Builder().header("X-Idempotency-Key", uuid) helper for callers who opt into retries.

build-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1902 - "Retry path duplicates streaming start on rotation; classify chunked bodies as non-retryable"

ana (DevEx): Thanks, I'll open the PR with tests.
